<thought>Since the tool requires bond specifications in numeric format, we will search the template catalog using only the functional group criterion that the forward reaction breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl group. This should retrieve templates for protecting alcohols with TMSOTf. We'll then select the first returned template, retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES, and provide the required output.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC[Si](C)(C)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
